business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail Agency for Equities, CFDs and Derivative Instruments

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France-United States Tax Convention (1994, as amended by the 2009 Protocol)
France-Hong Kong Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (1997)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier, arts. L.561-1 et seq. (AML/CFT obligations) and arts. L.561-45 to L.561-49 (declaration of beneficial owner); Décret n° 2016-1445 du 24 octobre 2016 (UBO register); Décret n° 2020-100 du 6 février 2020 and Ordonnance n° 2020-115 du 11 février 2020 (transposition of the 5th and 6th EU Anti-Money Laundering Directives); SARL requirements set out in Code de commerce, arts. L.223-1 to L.223-43; AMF General Regulation, Book III on investment service providers; ACPR Instruction n° 2018-I-01 on authorisation procedures.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport or national identity card of each UBO and proposed manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public notary, municipal authority, or French consular authority in the document holder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if the country is a party to the 1961 Hague Convention) or Consular Legalization by the French Embassy or Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public utility company or financial institution in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized apostilled copy or French consular legalization; must be accompanied by a certified French translation by an authorised translator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and current statutory extract of any shareholder that is a legal person
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the shareholder's place of incorporation (e.g., Companies House, Hong Kong Companies Registry, etc.)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization; notarized translation into French if the original is not in French

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference and source-of-wealth letter covering the source of funds for share capital and initial brokerage operations
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank or financial institution holding the applicant's funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostilled, legalized or notarized bank letter, with notarized signature and certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the power of attorney of any representative executing incorporation documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public notary in the country of execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or French Consular Legalization; certified French translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: The proposed SARL shall screen every UBO, director, manager and holder of internal control functions against the OFAC SDN and Blocked Persons List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions Database, French Treasury national financial sanctions, and domestic law-enforcement and criminal-record databases. PEP status must be determined using a maintained commercial PEP database with open-source adverse-media overlay. Screening must be repeated at least every 90 calendar days and immediately upon a material change. Enhanced due diligence, including source-of-wealth review and senior approval, is mandatory where any UBO or manager is a PEP or is sanctioned.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) for name reservation and incorporation filing; Infogreffe RCS database (www.infogreffe.fr) for prior name availability and existing conflict searches
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All statutory instruments and the corporate name must be in French or transliterated into Latin characters with a certified French translation where the original uses a non-Latin script. The corporate name must not be misleading, contrary to public order or morality, nor imply an unlicensed regulated activity. The suffix 'SARL' must appear at the end of the name and cannot be embedded in the operative part.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the INPI Guichet Unique or the Greffe of the competent commercial court refuses the requested name, the applicant may, within one month of notification, file a reasoned administrative appeal ('recours gracieux') with the same authority, attaching the receipt of refusal, a corrected name in two alternative forms, and evidence of distinguishability such as Kbis extracts, trademark filings and prior-use evidence. If the administrative appeal is rejected or no response issues within two months, the applicant may bring proceedings before the President of the competent Tribunal judiciaire under Article R.123-138 of the Code de commerce, seeking annulment of the refusal and registration of the name. A fresh name reservation application may be filed at any time if the original reservation window is still running or immediately after expiry; a single renewal is permitted if filed before the initial 120-day validity expires and no conflicting application has been received.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted for a regulated securities brokerage. A SARL must maintain a real 'siège social' in France at which statutory records, compliance documentation and risk-management functions are physically established. A domiciliation commerciale (managed office) is acceptable for ordinary commercial SARLs under Article L.123-11 of the Code de commerce, but it is not a substitute for the operational substance required by ACPR/AMF for retail securities brokerage, CFD execution and derivative broking.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High. ACPR and AMF may conduct on-site inspections ('contrôles sur place') at any time after authorisation; for a retail CFD and equities brokerage, the regulatory risk assessment indicates a greater than 70% likelihood of at least one unannounced physical inspection within the first 24 months of operation.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; fixed fee per screening pack

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified French translations, notarisation, apostilles and consular legalisation of foreign corporate and personal documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified translator, public notary, French consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariffs and certified-translation market rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory rate per inserted line and official publication tax

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff of approximately EUR 58 plus UBO declaration and RCS filing administrative fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: ACPR/AMF regulatory authorisation pre-feasibility assessment for ISIC 6611 retail securities brokerage
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; fixed fee for licence-readiness review and gap analysis

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL), L.210-1 et seq. (general commercial company provisions), and Decree No. 2023-306 on the Guichet Unique formalities platform.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Registry of the Commercial Court), operating through the Guichet Unique entrepreneur instituted by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Formulaire M0 accompanied by the signed Articles of Association (statuts) and the certificate of deposit of share capital, filed through the INPI Guichet Unique.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital required for an SARL; the capital is set freely in the Articles. Cash contributions must be paid up to at least 50% upon subscription, the balance within five years; in-kind contributions must be fully paid up at formation. Funds must be deposited in a blocked account held with a bank, notary, or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations until RCS registration is completed.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: that the incorporators accept the subscription and full payment of the share capital as set out in the Articles; that the Articles of Association be adopted; that the registered office be established at the address stated in the Articles; that [Name] be appointed manager (gérant) with full signatory authority to operate and represent the Company; that the manager be authorized to complete all registration formalities and to apply for the required financial services license before the AMF; and that these resolutions take immediate effect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI/Guichet Unique through www.inpi.fr or Infogreffe, using the French company name search database.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request or verify the proposed corporate name for identical or similar existing rights. Provide the SARL legal form, a detailed business purpose, and up to three alternative names. Upon approval, obtain a non-objection certificate or a reservation confirmation.
required_dossiers: Business scope description for securities brokerage
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If rejected because of identity or similarity, file an administrative challenge with INPI or immediately amend the name request; if no reply within the statutory time frame, treat the application as approved under the silence-as-acceptance principle.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate lawyer or business formalist; notary required only when the registered office consists of a real-property contribution or when notarized articles are indispensable for the transaction.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the statuts in French, setting out corporate name, object (restricted to ISIC 6611 securities brokerage), duration of 99 years, registered office, share capital, classes of shares, contribution details, management powers, share-transfer restrictions, audit thresholds, and dissolution provisions. Have all incorporators sign the articles, either privately or by notarial act.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry identifies non-compliant clauses, adopt a supplementary resolution to amend the articles and refile along with the original articles and the approval resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Blocking and deposit of share capital with banking institution or notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: An authorized credit institution, notary, or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations; the deposit certificate issuer must be independent from the future company's founders.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked account in the name of the SARL in formation. Deposit the cash contributions, obtaining a certificate of deposit from the bank or notary. Ensure at least 50% of cash shares is transferred to the blocked account before filing; the balance is callable within five years. Obtain a contribution auditor's report for in-kind contributions when statutory thresholds are met.
required_dossiers: Certificate of deposit of share capital
Bank receipt or notary receipt for each cash transfer
Valuation report for in-kind contributions if applicable
List of subscribers with contribution allocations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses to open an account due to the high-risk securities-brokerage activity, use a notary or an approved corporate-services bank; if refusal persists, request a letter of no-objection from the ACPR or adapt the scope of the corporate purpose to a holding-only vehicle pending regulatory approval.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of statutory legal announcement in a legal announcements journal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A journal authorized to publish legal announcements (Journal d'Annonces Légales) in the department of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish a formal notice stating the SARL legal form, corporate name, nominal capital, registered office address, corporate object, duration, managers' names, and the competent RCS court. The notice must appear within eight days before the filing of the formation dossier.
required_dossiers: Proof of publication issued by the chosen legal announcements journal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notice contains an error or is rejected, publish a corrective notice in the same journal and ensure the corrected publication date is within the applicable filing window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of the full formation dossier to the Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique managed by INPI; transmission to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce and INSEE.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the electronic M0 form on the Guichet Unique portal and upload all documents. Sign electronically with an advanced electronic signature. Select the appropriate NACE/APE code corresponding to ISIC 6611 brokerage. Submit the dossier, which will be routed automatically to the competent commercial court registry.
required_dossiers: Proof of registered office address or domiciliation agreement
Valid identification documents for each manager
Declaration of good conduct and non-bankruptcy for each manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the file is queried, the registry will send a notice of incompleteness with a fixed curing deadline; supply the omitted documents and preserve the same file number. If the application is refused, appeal before the competent commercial court judge or file a fresh request after correcting the defects.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS registration and issuance of Kbis extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office; INSEE for SIREN/SIRET assignment.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon validation of the formation dossier, the registry enters the company in the Register of Commerce and Companies, assigns the SIREN and SIRET numbers, and issues the official Kbis extract. The Kbis constitutes the irrefutable proof of the company's legal existence and must be obtained before commencing regulated activities.
required_dossiers: Identification of the registered office and managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration is denied, an appeal may be lodged with the president of the commercial court in summary proceedings within 15 days from notification; alternatively, correct the grounds and resubmit the full dossier with an explanatory cover letter.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Autorité des Marchés Financiers (AMF) and Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) for the investment-services license; for premises and industrial/physical compliance, the Direction Régionale de l'Économie, de l'Emploi, du Travail et des Solidarités (DREETS) and the local Mayor's police authority.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Agrément de Prestataire de Services d'Investissement (PSI) for retail securities and derivative brokerage, or an equivalent AMF registration under the digital-asset framework where applicable; no separate industrial operating permit is required for pure office-based brokerage.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL), under the Ministry of Ecological Transition.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Non-classé — a financial brokerage business with only office occupancy does not require a full EIA report or preliminary environmental registration under the ICPE classification; an EIA could be required only if the office uses hazardous installations or is located in a protected zone.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC process emissions are generated in pure brokerage activity; office wastewater must comply with municipal sanitation network limits. Waste disposal must follow Code de l'environnement sorting rules and WEEE Directive 2012/19/EU for electronic equipment. Any cooling systems must comply with F-gas Regulation (EU) No 517/2014 and energy-efficiency thresholds under Ecodesign Regulation (EU) 2023/826.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance from the Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours (SDIS) and a fire safety certificate for the premises classified as an ERP (établissement recevant du personnel), including smoke detectors, extinguishers, emergency exits, and evacuation plans. Structural load inspection and approval of the leased premises from the building owner's technical file, especially for server rooms or heavy trading floors. Occupational health compliance must be validated by the regional occupational health service (SSTI) and CARSAT, including electrical safety verification, first-aid equipment, and the mandatory Document Unique d'Évaluation des Risques Professionnels (DUERP).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France, with prudential supervision for banks and e-money institutions exercised by the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) and balance-of-payments/foreign-exchange statistical control administered under the Direction Générale du Trésor.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France applies full capital and current account convertibility under EU Treaty free-movement provisions; the euro is freely convertible and no exchange licence is required for lawful current commercial settlements or capital movements. Dividend and profit remittances from a French SARL to non-resident shareholders are permitted without prior foreign-exchange approval, subject to corporate formalities, tax withholding certification or treaty relief, and anti-money-laundering source-of-funds verification. For a regulated securities broker, inward foreign capital is additionally screened by the bank through KYC/AML controls and by the reporting obligations applicable to financial transactions exceeding statutory thresholds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France does not impose any surrender, repatriation, or mandatory conversion ratio for export proceeds. Export receipts may be freely retained in foreign currency or converted to EUR. However, French resident companies must report cross-border transactions to the Banque de France for balance-of-payments statistical purposes when thresholds or defined categories are triggered; cash movements of €10,000 or more require customs declaration; and direct investment and foreign account balances above the statutory reporting limits must be declared annually.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Client-Funds Segregated Escrow Account / Operational Treasury Account
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Settlement Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FX Hedging and Liquidity Clearing Account / Escrow for Regulatory Capital
Securities Transaction Settlement Account / Operational Account
Cross-Border Correspondent Clearing Account / Client Money Bond Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. A French-regulated electronic money institution (approved by ACPR) may provide e-money wallets and payment accounts for operating expenses, but it is not a viable full-service treasury counterparty for a high-risk offshore securities brokerage requiring segregated client funds, FX hedging, and regulated settlement services. Unlicensed offshore digital EMIs are not acceptable as primary banking rails because their source-of-funds verification, audit trail, and sub-account structures are generally insufficient for French AML/KYC and the ACPR interpretation of safeguarding obligations. Any EMI solution must hold a French or EEA licence, provide segregated safeguarding accounts with a credit institution, and be acceptable to the French statutory auditor.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French banks treat a high-risk ISIC 6611 securities broker as requiring senior management and beneficial owners to submit to an in-person KYC interview at the bank's premises or a French notary, unless the client qualifies for a fully electronic qualified electronic-signature equivalence process under ACPR guidelines. In practice, Tier 1 French banks require physical presence for the legal representative and a compliance meeting covering ownership, source of wealth, anticipated transaction flows, and regulatory licence evidence. Remote opening is theoretically possible with eIDAS signature and secure video identity verification, but for a high-risk broker most credit institutions insist on a physical or notarially apostilled presence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Entity owns a regulatory licence for high-risk retail derivatives brokerage with high-volume cross-border client payments.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the ACPR or EU securities licence; the AMF registration certificate; constitutional documents of the SARL; audited financial statements; structural and business-activity narrative; transaction-monitoring and sanctions-screening policy; outsourcing and treasury policy; list of correspondent banks and projected monthly clearing volumes; source-of-funds evidence for regulatory capital; tax compliance certificate from the French tax authorities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner is resident in or funds originate from a higher-risk or non-Article 29 jurisdiction in the FATF/GAFI context.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid passports and proof of residence for all natural persons at 25% or more; registry of beneficial owners (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs); bank references from the sending institution; independent professional asset-verification reports; source-of-wealth letters; tax returns or tax residence certificates; explanation of the economic purpose of the broker cross-holding chain; sanctions and PEP screening results.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Treasury operations require swift movement between segregated client accounts, escrow accounts, and broker operational accounts that may be interpreted as misuse of client money.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Client money management and reconciliation policy compliant with Articles L.533-10 et seq. and R.533-11 et seq. of the French Monetary and Financial Code; daily segregation and reconciliation methodology; agreement with the bank on the operating structure; legal opinion on client asset safeguarding and custody; internal audit sign-off; ACPR reporting acknowledgements; bank-issued attestation of client-money account designations.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound shareholder capital, subordinated loans, or liquidity injections from the offshore parent must be routed via SWIFT MT103/MT202 for USD or other foreign currency, or SEPA Credit Transfer / TARGET2 in EUR using the SARL's IBAN at a French Tier 1 bank. The bank mandate shall record the payment reference using a recognised EU/French balance-of-payments code for 'direct investment – equity capital' or 'intercompany treasury operations' plus the underlying transaction identifiers. For compliance, the bank will require a board resolution approving the injection, evidence of source of funds, confirmation that no administrative authorisation is required under the French Monetary and Financial Code, and an instrument or share-issuance certificate. Funds intended for securities settlement or client-money cover are not interchangeable and must be separately designated before crediting; escrow and operational rails must not be commingled.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade and treasury disbursements are cleared through (i) SWIFT MT103/MT202 for cross-currency settlement through the clearing account at HSBC Continental Europe or BNP Paribas, (ii) SEPA Instant Credit Transfer for EUR payments up to the network limit for broker operating expenses and counterparty margin settlements, and (iii) documentary or standby commercial letters of credit issued under UCP 600 only for physical trade-related deals, not for client equities, CFDs or derivatives. For settlement of client securities transactions, delivery-versus-payment (DVP) through a French CSD or an international central securities depository is mandatory; the bank must confirm that outgoing settlement instructions carry proper field 72 bank-to-bank and ISO 20022 transaction-type codes to distinguish own funds, client money, and the broker's proprietary capital. FX settlement is affected on a payment-versus-payment basis using CLS eligible currency pairs where available; otherwise simultaneous / two-legged MT103 payments with confirmation matching.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) limited to genuine economic exposure on non-convertible underlying currencies
